FastBorder is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments intact and, when capture is on, recorded as tag 1 with the first 20 stack words; every register is restored
StrBlt is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments intact and, when capture is on, recorded as tag 2 with the first 20 stack words; every register is restored
DIBTODEVICE_FWD is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments intact and, when capture is on, recorded as tag 3 with the first 20 stack words; every register is restored
STRETCHDIBITS_FWD is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments intact and, when capture is on, recorded as tag 4 with the first 20 stack words; every register is restored
ScanLR is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments intact and, when capture is on, recorded as tag 5 with the first 20 stack words; every register is restored
Pixel is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments intact and, when capture is on, recorded as tag 6 with the first 20 stack words; every register is restored
the raw capture keeps 16 slots and counts the calls it drops
the capture escape returns an Output call that went to DIBENG (style, point count, first point, pen fields, Rop2) and the raw FastBorder arguments
the capture escape stop switches the raw capture off

StretchDIBits 2x 24-bit bottom-up: the engine request carries the destination origin, factors 2 and 2, the whole source rectangle, the visible rectangle, the DIB bits linear address, stride, depth, height and byte length; the call returns the number of source scan lines and DIBENG is not called
StretchDIBits 3x 32-bit top-down: factor 3, stride W*4, top-down flag, visible rectangle clamped to the 64x48 screen
StretchDIBits 555 source rectangle 3,2 10x7 2x: the source rows are counted from the bottom (start row 13-2-7 = 4), whatever the direction of the DIB
StretchDIBits top-down DIB with a source rectangle (or a partial bitmap: StartScan/cLines reach the DDI as such a rectangle): stays with DIBENG, only whole top-down bitmaps are taken
StretchDIBits: the clip rectangle narrows the visible rectangle (right and bottom exclusive)
StretchDIBits: a clip rectangle larger than the destination changes nothing
StretchDIBits 2x on a small source
StretchDIBits anisotropic 3x2: the factors go through unchanged for the VxD to class
StretchDIBits 8-bit source: the request carries the colour table (biClrUsed 40 entries as 0x00RRGGBB dwords, the other 216 zero), pal_n 40, stride and byte length for 8 bits a pixel
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with biClrUsed 0: all 256 colour table entries are passed
StretchDIBits 8-bit top-down whole bitmap is taken
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with a translation table (index colours): stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with biClrUsed over 256: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with a compression code that is neither RLE8 nor 0 (BITFIELDS): stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with RLE8 without biSizeImage: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with RLE4 compression on an 8-bit bitmap: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 8-bit source with RLE8 top-down: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 4-bit source at 32bpp: src_bits 4, stride in bytes of 4 bits a pixel, 16 colour table entries (biClrUsed 0 = all), the rest zero
StretchDIBits 4-bit source with biClrUsed 9: nine table entries
StretchDIBits 1-bit source at 32bpp: src_bits 1, stride 4 bytes, two table entries
StretchDIBits 1-bit top-down whole bitmap is taken
StretchDIBits 4-bit top-down with a source rectangle stays with DIBENG (as every top-down sub-rectangle)
StretchDIBits RLE8 source at 32bpp: flag 4, src_stride = src_width = the width, src_bytes = biSizeImage, the colour table of the header
StretchDIBits RLE4 source at 32bpp: flag 4, src_bits 4, width and stream length as for RLE8
StretchDIBits 4-bit with biClrUsed 17: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 1-bit with biClrUsed 3: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 1-bit with a translation table: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 4-bit RLE8 mismatch: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits 1-bit with any compression: stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits RLE8 bigger than the decode buffer (4096 x 100): stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits RLE8 with a stream over 16 MB: stays with DIBENG

StretchDIBits stays with DIBENG when: fGet set (read the screen into a DIB), ROP other than SRCCOPY, destination not a multiple of the source (21 -> 40), destination height not a multiple, negative destination width (mirror), negative destination height (mirror), BI_BITFIELDS / compressed source, 4-bit source, two planes, source rectangle past the right edge, source rectangle past the top, empty source width, no bits, no info, clip leaves nothing, destination entirely off the right edge, not the screen device
StretchDIBits stays with DIBENG when the device is not in video memory or is flagged busy
StretchDIBits stays with DIBENG when acceleration is disabled (wEnabled 0), and works again when it is back
StretchDIBits: when the VxD declines (class not enabled, size, 3D busy...) the call is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments, return value from DIBENG
StretchDIBits: a lost engine answer disables the GDI device, sets BUSY, and the call still goes to DIBENG
StretchDIBits 1:1 (a top-down bitmap reaches the driver this way) is sent to the VxD with factors 1 and 1
StretchDIBits 1:1 top-down with a source rectangle stays with DIBENG
StretchDIBits with a negative destination x: the signed origin goes to the VxD and the visible rectangle starts at 0
StretchDIBits with a negative destination y likewise

DibToDevice with a negative X (a source rectangle drawn at the left edge): signed origin, visible rectangle from the clip
DibToDevice without a clip rectangle: the picture clamped to the screen
DibToDevice running off the screen: clamped to 64x48
DibToDevice stays with DIBENG when: iScan not 0, cScans not the height, top-down bitmap, BITFIELDS 24-bit, 4-bit, no bits, no info, 565 BITFIELDS into a 16bpp screen, clip leaves nothing
DibToDevice: when the VxD declines the call is forwarded to DIBENG with its arguments and DIBENG answers
DibToDevice: a lost engine disables the GDI device, sets BUSY and the call goes to DIBENG
StretchDIBits at a 32bpp desktop: the request carries bpp 32
StretchDIBits at 32bpp with a 5-6-5 BITFIELDS source: flagged as 565
